parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next page of results. Valid values:

- If this is your first query or no next page exists, do not specify this parameter.

- If a next page exists, set the value to the **NextToken** value returned from the previous call.

parameters.name: TrafficQosPolicyDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the QoS policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: TrafficQosPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the QoS policy.

parameters.name: TrafficQosPolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the QoS policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the inter-region connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the TransitRouter instance.
